label: sec:q-opers-intro
html: We turn to the spectral side of the conjecture and the canonical objects that realise it. We introduce the q-oper: a \check{G}_q-bundle on X, equipped with a reduction to the Borel subgroup and a q-flat connection in oper position. This object provides the rigid spectral data dual to the automorphic q-Hecke eigensheaves. The fibre functor maps every q-oper to a q-Hecke eigensheaf, with the eigenvalue determined by the oper coordinates. This concretely realises the abstract Tannakian mediation.
